To Whom It May Concern,  

I’ve collaborated with Isabella Rossi on two cross-functional projects at HealthTrack Innovations, where she led Android development for their flagship app. Her work on integrating wearable data synchronization saw a 35% reduction in latency compared to the prior version, improving user retention.  

Isabella’s strength lies in Android development, where she owns end-to-end workflows from design to production. She recently refactored a legacy module, reducing crash rates by 40% and enabling new features in 6 weeks. Her Flutter expertise shone when she built a cross-platform dashboard, cutting development time by 25% while maintaining consistency across iOS and Android. She also contributed to Swift-based iOS enhancements, ensuring seamless integration with Apple HealthKit.  

A standout aspect is her attention to responsive design—she redesigned the medication tracker’s UI, boosting task completion rates by 20% in A/B tests. Her ability to balance technical rigor with user-centric thinking is rare.  

Isabella is a self-starter who thrives in tight deadlines. During a recent sprint, she pivoted to Kotlin for a critical feature, delivering it 2 days ahead of schedule. Her curiosity and willingness to experiment, like prototyping a Flutter-based telehealth interface, elevate team innovation.
